q1.instructions:
In the text below, a name was found at the words wrapped in [[ ]]. Each option wraps a slightly different stretch of the text. Pick the option that wraps exactly the whole name. A punctuation mark that is part of the name's own spelling belongs inside it. A mark that belongs to the sentence around the name stays outside.

Text: "[[Imagine]]" was written by John Lennon
